checks.text: With no image loaded, the drop zone shows the text "Drop an image or click to browse".

After loading a 512x512 PNG named "logo.png" through the drop zone, the preview region shows the text "logo.png" and the "Generated sizes" list shows eight items with the texts "16x16", "32x32", "48x48", "64x64", "128x128", "192x192", "256x256" and "512x512".
After loading logo.png, selecting "Square" in the select labelled "Crop shape" and clicking the button "Apply" keeps the preview showing "logo.png" and the list still has eight items.
After loading logo.png, selecting "Circle" in "Crop shape" and clicking "Apply" keeps the preview showing "logo.png" and the list still has eight items.
After loading logo.png, setting the slider labelled "Quality" to "80" and clicking "Apply" keeps the preview showing "logo.png" and the list still has eight items.
After loading logo.png, clicking the button "Download all" triggers a download whose suggested filename is "favicons.zip".
After loading logo.png, clicking the button "Download 16x16" triggers a download whose suggested filename is "favicon-16x16.png".
After loading logo.png and reloading the page, the preview region still shows "logo.png" and the "Generated sizes" list still has an item with the text "16x16".
